items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and approve only one report-only finance reconciliation using existing read-only records. Revenue is supported only as provider-level Amazon aggregate data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; the aggregate income cannot be assigned to any site. September AI usage is $988.91 across 5,470 calls, with 233 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, ROI, payback, budget headroom, burn rate, runway, and forecast revenue are not calculable because revenue is not period-aligned or fully attributable, infrastructure/vendor costs are absent, and monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, revenue-target, and revenue-floor fields are blank. Do not authorize incremental spend or rely on impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, approved proposals, or shipped output as financial results. No money movement, billing changes, banking access, contracts, or external spend.

Minimum measurement for the next finance review: reconcile a dated daily ledger of AI, hosting/runtime, domains/registrars, analytics/data services, and other vendor costs by site and workstream to period-aligned shipped commission; retain provider tracking IDs, ordered items, shipped items, commission, refunds or reversals if available, and verified outcome deltas. Until those fields exist, preserve all cost and revenue gaps as unknown and make no financial forecast.
